body: I strain my eyes, scanning the dense forest for any sign of movement, my heart pounding in anticipation. The silence that follows my name is oppressive, and I can feel the weight of expectation on my shoulders. I think about the trees, their branches swaying gently in the breeze, and the sounds of the forest creatures, but nothing seems to match the urgency in my voice.
